data.text:
The evidence shows a clear radio capacity congestion incident on site S-TUN-004 between 18:45 and 19:45 on 2026-09-26 (ALR-0032, T1, T3). During this window, active users surged (up to 469, z=10.9), traffic, drop rate, latency, and PRB utilisation spiked, accompanied by a warning alarm `HIGH_PRB` (T5, ALM-000601). No external events were found in TUN (T4), no maintenance or changes occurred on S-TUN-004 or its parents (T6, T7), and sibling sites S-TUN-016 and S-TUN-018 showed no congestion (T3). The signature perfectly matches radio congestion as described in runbook [RB-CONGESTION#02].

Since all evidence points to localized radio capacity congestion without external events, changes, or hardware faults, the investigation is complete.

data.markdown:
# Radio Capacity Congestion on S-TUN-004

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** capacity at `S-TUN-004`
- **Confidence:** high (Direct telemetry and alarm evidence match the runbook signature precisely, with external events and changes ruled out.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-26 18:45 to 2026-09-26 19:47
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-26 18:45
- **Affected:** S-TUN-004

## Summary

Radio capacity congestion due to an unexpected surge in active users and traffic exceeding cell design limits.

Customers experienced very slow speeds and increased latency on site S-TUN-004 between 18:45 and 19:47.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-26 18:45: Earliest KPI onset and alert ALR-0032 started on S-TUN-004. [T1, T3, ALR-0032]
- 2026-09-26 18:55: Warning alarm HIGH_PRB raised on S-TUN-004. [T5, ALM-000601]
- 2026-09-26 19:47: HIGH_PRB alarm cleared on S-TUN-004. [T5, ALM-000601]

## Evidence

- Active users surged on S-TUN-004 from a baseline of 158 to 469. [ANM-000394]
- Download volume spiked on S-TUN-004 from 10672 to 35989. [ANM-000395]
- Drop rate rose on S-TUN-004 from 0.61 to 3.25 percent. [ANM-000396]
- No external events were found in region TUN between 18:00 and 00:00. [T4]
- No changes occurred on S-TUN-004, AGG-TUN-02, or LNK-TUN-02-A between 18:00 and 23:59. [T6]
- No maintenance window was scheduled on S-TUN-004 or its parents. [T7]

## Hypotheses

1. **capacity** at S-TUN-004: confirmed. Active users and traffic surged while PRB utilisation spiked, matching the radio capacity congestion signature. [RB-CONGESTION#02, ALM-000601, ANM-000394]
2. **expected_event** at S-TUN-004: rejected. No external events were recorded in region TUN during the incident window. [T4, RB-CONGESTION#03]

## Ruled out

- T4: External events check returned no events for region TUN, ruling out a stadium or public event.
- T6: Change management check showed no configuration changes on the site or its transport link.
- T7: Maintenance check confirmed no scheduled works on the site or its ancestors.
- ALM-000600: Minor VSWR alarm on sibling site S-TUN-016 cleared quickly and did not impact S-TUN-004.
- ALM-000603: Minor VSWR alarm on sibling site S-TUN-016 was unrelated to the congestion on S-TUN-004.

## Recommended actions

- Monitor traffic trends on S-TUN-004 during peak evening hours.
- Evaluate cell capacity expansion or carrier addition for S-TUN-004.
